transactioncolumncustomfield.description: The Inventory Adjustment that executed this split, for audit. Written by the server when the split completes. Read-only on purpose so the audit link cannot be edited away from the transaction it points at. NOTE: a transactioncolumncustomfield cannot be DISABLED or INLINE in SDF, both are rejected at validation, so read-only is enforced by the Split Capture client script instead of by this definition.
transactioncolumncustomfield.help: Link to the Inventory Adjustment that split the bundle. Set automatically.
transactioncolumncustomfield.label: Split Inventory Adjustment
